notes: Single user-facing config for 5-camera event+MVS+YOLO+HIT+OpenGL. Event-side human mask is NON-BLOCKING: it filters only if the matching mask is already available; hit_judge does strong body-motion rejection later.

mvs_config.notes: 8-camera HIK MVS soft-trigger profile with event-camera ready-file sync.

opengl_renderer.notes: Run fusion_renderer_gl.py as a separate process. MVS frames are published through sync.mvs_frame_pub_*; event overlays are read from existing event_overlay_latest_* shared memory.

hit_judge.note: Impact-sync candidate layer with human fallback, trigger period quality check, per-impact debug JSONL, and point+trajectory geometry evidence. This still emits candidates/debug, not final hit_confirmed. v6: projected mask crossing is pending only; final hit requires absorb/disappear or bounce near current human mask boundary.
